name: Zero rule (state form)
summary: In the presence of the zero scalar, the Z-state can be replaced by the X-state.
description:
The simplified version of the [zero rule](../zero-rule/) used in the minimal axiomatisation of the stabilizer ZX-calculus by Backens, Perdrix and Wang: next to the zero scalar (a Z-spider with phase π and no legs), a phase-free Z-state can be replaced by a phase-free X-state. Both sides are the zero vector.

Together with the other simplified rules this implies the original zero rule and the [zero scalar rule](../zero-scalar-rule/), and it cannot be derived from the remaining axioms.
